payload.title: Fixed 50 percent U projection replicates safely across independent bases
payload.statement: The exact T060 50% robust U projection will reproduce aggregate gains without violating family-specific tail gates when applied across the frozen independent base set.
payload.evidence_for: The fixed action continued to show broad aggregate structural improvement, confirming the sign and representation were not accidental.
payload.evidence_against: Replication preserved the decisive tail failure, including on the E011 family, so the 50% action remained unsafe.
payload.next_test: Freeze one tail-safe 25% projection and require all registered bases, spatial cells, fold cells, and bootstraps to improve before live packaging.
